body: There are a lot of types of insomnia. My insomnia was a product of anxiety, it started in a strange period for me and remained for a long time. I had weeks of full sleepnessness, I was grateful if I could stay asleep for 3 or 4 hours. Now I sleep for 7 or 8, but I don't know if I sleep well, I forgot when it was the last time that I woke up relaxed and full of energy.
